Account overview: Elmbridge Cortex Labs (mid-market SaaS, customer intelligence). Started with Hosted API for quick integration into their support-agent and search flows; now pushing for Dedicated to meet data residency and tighter latency SLOs.

Key signal from product: "Hosted was easy to integrate but traffic variability and PII residency are blockers. Need Dedicated with VPC and KMS for production workloads."

Commercials: POC requested for Dedicated (6 weeks), baseline committed capacity target ~$15k/month with burst pricing. Looking for 12–24 month committed contract; procurement prefers annual. Target ARR band $120k–$300k.

Legal / Procurement updates: Legal sent initial MSA/DPA redlines 2026-03-02 (see thread-BEEF5678). Security posture: SOC2 Type II present; still require on-premises-equivalent controls for logs (audit_logging), KMS integration (customer key), SSO via SAML, and EU data residency for a subset of customers (they have EU customers).
